opening.argument: The presentation is a conventional holiday promotion for Texas Roadhouse gift cards, with Santa-themed messaging, restaurant imagery, and a family dining scene establishing an ordinary gift-giving and dining context. The narration expressly says, “This holiday season give Santa approved gift cards from Texas Roadhouse,” then directs viewers to personalize a card and states it is “Available at all locations or online at TexasRoadhouse.com.” The visible gift-card form, with To, From, and Amount lines, reinforces a standard retail purchase and personalization process. Nothing presented involves an investment, credential request, prize scheme, or deceptive participation flow; the requested action is simply to obtain a restaurant gift card through stated Texas Roadhouse locations or websites.
